```{r}
library(haven)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(PatientProfiles)
library(visOmopResults)
library(here)
library(readxl)
library(omopgenerics)

dataFolder <- "/storage/home/nm1242/doxycyclineSafety/Data"
marketscan <- read_sas(here(dataFolder, "master_file_3subgroups_marketscan_oct26.sas7bdat"), NULL)
medicaid <- read_sas(here(dataFolder, "master_file_3subgroups_medicaid_oct26.sas7bdat"), NULL)
```

# Cohort Size and Columns

Medicaid cohort table has `r nrow(medicaid)` rows and `r ncol(medicaid)` columns, while MarketScan has `r nrow(marketscan)` and `r ncol(marketscan)`, respectively.

## Columns in cohorts
Column names grouped into different categories. En-dash indicates that the variables is not present for that data source (highlighted rows).

```{r}
all <- c(colnames(medicaid), colnames(marketscan)) |>
  unique() |>
  sort()

categories <- list(
  "Identification columns" = c(
    "MotherId", "pregnancy_id", "exposure", "exposure_start", 
    "exposure_end", "IndexDt", "lmp_art"
  ),
  "Age" = all[grepl("age|Age", all)],
  "Infant sex" = all[grepl("Infant_", all)],
  "Obstetric conditions" = c("OCS", "OCS_0", "OCS_1", "OCS_2", "OCS_GE3", "repeated_preg"),
  "Race" = all[grepl("race", all)],
  "State/Region" = all[grepl("region|state", all)],
  "Substance Use/Abuse" = c("alcohol_abuse", "smoking", "substance_abuse"),
  "Delivery year" = all[grepl("year|Year", all)],
  "Conditions" = c(
    "anemia", "diabetes_pregest", "epilepsy_convulsions",
    "hypertension_pregest", "obesity_overweight",
    "renal_disease", "thyroid_disease", "anxiety", "depression"
  ),
  "Medications" = c(
    "acetaminophen", "antidiabetics", "antihypertensives",
    "corticosteroids", "folate_suppl", "immunosuppressant",
    "insulin", "nsaids", "teratogen_suspected"
  ),
  "Indications ([LMP-90, LMP-1])" = all[grepl("w1", all)],
  "Indications ([LMP, LMP+90])" = all[grepl("w2", all)],
  "Healthcare utilization" = all[grepl("Num", all)],
  "Outcomes" =  c('Abdominal_Wall', 'ASD', 'AV_Septal_Defect', 'Cardiac', 'Central_Nervous_System', 'Cleft_Lip_All', 'Cleft_Palate_Alone', 'Conotruncal_Defects', 'depression', 'Ear_Anomalies', 'Eye_Anomalies', 'Gastrointestinal', 'Genital', 'Hypospadias', 'Limb_defects', 'MAIN_Malform_Overall', 'Musculoskeletal', 'Oral_cleft', 'Oral_cleft_New_2', 'Other', 'Other_vascular', 'PDA', 'Respiratory_malformations', 'Single_Ventricle', 'Urinary', 'Ventricular_Septal_Defect')
)

# Create category/column table
result <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  categories,
  \(columns, category) {
    tibble::tibble(
      category = category,
      columns = columns
    )
  }
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    "Missing rows, N(%)\nMedicaid" = purrr::map_dbl(
      columns,
      \(col) {
        if (!col %in% names(medicaid)) {
          NA_real_
        } else {
          mean(is.na(medicaid[[col]])) * 100
        }
      }
    ),
    "Missing rows, N(%)\nMarketScan" = purrr::map_dbl(
      columns,
      \(col) {
        if (!col %in% names(marketscan)) {
          NA_real_
        } else {
          mean(is.na(marketscan[[col]])) * 100
        }
      }
    )
  )

result |>
  rename("Columns" = "columns", "Category" = "category") |>
  formatTable(type = "flextable")

```


## Differences with requested 

```{r}
requestedCovariates <- read_xlsx(path = here(dataFolder, "Doxycycline_variables_10282025.xlsx"), sheet = "Covariates")
requestedIndications <- read_xlsx(path = here(dataFolder, "Doxycycline_variables_10282025.xlsx"), sheet = "Indications_list")

covariateDiff <- setdiff(tolower(requestedCovariates$Variable), tolower(all))
indicationDiff <- setdiff(tolower(requestedIndications$Variable), gsub("w2_|w1_", "", tolower(all)))
```

**Covariates requested but not present in data:** `r paste0(covariateDiff, collapse = ", ")`

**Indications requested but not present in data:** `r paste0(indicationDiff, collapse = ", ")`

## Population Characteristics

```{r}
tableOne <- importSummarisedResult(here("Results",  c("table_one_marketscan.csv", "table_one_medicaid.csv")))
tableOne |>
  mutate(
    cdm_name = factor(cdm_name, c("Medicaid", "MarketScan")),
    variable_name = factor(
      variable_name,
      levels = c(
        "number records", "number subjects", 
        "age", "age_category", "infant_sex", "race", "region", "state", "ocs", "ocs_category", "repeated_preg", 
        "Substance Use/Abuse [LMP-90, LMP+90]",
        "Comorbidities [LMP-90, Delivery]",
        "Medications [LMP-90, LMP+90]",
        "num_dx3", "number_diagnosis_category",
        "num_generics_no_antibiotic", "number_generics_no_antibiotics_category",
        "num_out_visits_dx", "number_outpatient_visits_category",
        "num_hosp", "number_hospitalisations_category",
        "num_ed_visits", "number_ed_visits_category",
        "Indications [LMP-90, LMP+90]", "Indications [LMP-90, LMP-1]", "Indications [LMP, LMP+90]",
        "delivery_year_category", "delivery_year"
      )
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(cdm_name, group_level, variable_name, variable_level) |>
  visOmopTable(
    type = "flextable",
    estimateName = c(
      "N (%)" = "<count> (<percentage>)",
      "N" = "<count>",
      "Median [Q25 - Q75]" = "<median> [<q25> - <q75>]",
      "Mean (SD)" = "<mean> (<sd>)",
      "Range: Min-Max" = "<min> - <max>"
    ),
    header = c("cdm_name", "exposure")
  )
```
